original: クラトスは、その忍びの里ってとこに\n行った事があるのよね？
traducao: Kratos, you've been to that ninja\nvillage before, haven't you?

original: ねえねえ、どんなトコだったの？
traducao: Come on, tell me, what was it like?

original: その質問には答えられん。\n忍びの里とは文字通り、世間と一線を引き\n忍びながら生きるものの地
traducao: I cannot answer that.\nA ninja village is a land for those\nwho live in complete secrecy.

original: 本来であれば、その存在すら\n他言無用にすべき隠れ里なのだ
traducao: Normally, its very existence is a secret\nthat should never be spoken of.

original: でも、私達は今その里へ\n向かってるワケでしょ？
traducao: Still, we're heading toward that\nvery village right now, aren't we?

original: 遅かれ早かれ知る事になるなら、\n別に今だって……
traducao: If we'll find out sooner or later,\nwhat's the harm in now...?

original: 遅かれ早かれ知る事になるのだ。\n焦る事はなかろう
traducao: You will learn sooner or later.\nThere is no need to rush.

original: 何よそれ。\nそんな我慢が出来るなら\n初めから聞いたりなんかしてないわよ
traducao: What kind of answer is that? If I had\nthat kind of patience, I wouldn't\nhave asked in the first place!

original: ま、いいわ……
traducao: Well, whatever...

original: 絶対、あきらめないから∀
traducao: I'm definitely not giving up! :)

original: 先程の様なトラップが、この坑道に\nまだあるかもしれん
traducao: Traps like the one from earlier\nmay still remain in this tunnel.

original: 私が知らぬ間に新たな仕掛けが\n施されている可能性もある
traducao: There is also the possibility that new\ncontraptions have been installed.

original: くれぐれも勝手な行動は……
traducao: Under no circumstances should you...

original: おお〜〜★　何かしらこれ。\nふんふん…硬質な植物の外皮を削り出して\n槍状にしたのね！
traducao: Oooh~! What could this be?\nHmm... they carved the outer husk of\na hard plant into spearheads!

original: という事は、近くにこれを使った\nカラクリとやらが……∀
traducao: Which means nearby there must be some\ncontraption that uses them! :)

original: ハロルド。\n聞いているのか
traducao: Harold.\nAre you listening to me?

original: あら、聞いてるわよ
traducao: Oh, I'm listening.

original: 勝手な行動は\nつつしめって言うんでしょ？
traducao: You're telling me to refrain\nfrom rash conduct, right?

original: 坑道なだけに∀
traducao: Conduct in a conduit! :)

original: あらやだ、本気にしちゃった？\n冗談よ、冗談
traducao: Oh dear, did you take that seriously?\nIt was just a joke, a joke!

original: 世話をかけたな
traducao: Thank you for looking after him.

original: おかげで、ロイドもまた一つ\n成長する事が出来た様だ
traducao: Thanks to you, it seems Lloyd has\ntaken another step toward maturity.

original: ……お前は不思議だな。\nただそこにそうしているだけで\n自然と周りへ、いい影響を与えていく
traducao: ......You are a curious one.\nJust by being present as you are,\nyou naturally influence those around you.

original: 今の気持ちを忘れるな。\n己が成し遂げたいと思う事、\n歩まんとする道筋を見失わずにいる事だ
traducao: Do not forget how you feel right now.\nKeep hold of what you wish to achieve,\nand never lose sight of your chosen path.

original: お前は……見失わずにいて欲しい
traducao: You, at least...... must never lose it.

original: さて、と。\nそろそろ仕上げに\nミソを入れようかしら？
traducao: Now then...\nShall I add the miso\nto finish things off?

original: お待ちになって。\nその前に、隠し味も用意しませんと
traducao: Wait! Before that, we must prepare\nour secret ingredient as well.

original: メロンなどが\nふさわしいのではなくて？
traducao: Wouldn't melon be\nmost appropriate?

original: そうね……。\nあ、それならついでに\nマグロも入れてみましょう
traducao: Good point...\nAh, in that case, let us add\nsome tuna as well.

original: 魚に含まれている栄養素には、\n脳の活性化を促す作用があるの
traducao: The nutrients contained in fish\nhelp stimulate brain activity.

original: 何で、あいつらが飯作ってんだよ！
traducao: Why the hell are THEY making food?!

original: 俺が知るかよ！\n気が付いたら、こうなってたんだ！
traducao: How should I know?!\nBy the time I noticed, it was like this!

original: これぐらい煮込めば\nよろしいんじゃありません？
traducao: Should this be simmered\nsufficiently by now?

original: ええ、そうね。\nあとは盛り付けをして……
traducao: Yes, indeed.\nAll that remains is serving it, and...

original: ちょっと待ったー！
traducao: Hold on just a minute!

original: あら、リタ。\n突然どうなさいましたの？
traducao: Oh, Rita.\nWhatever is the matter all of a sudden?

original: は〜〜〜〜。\n全くあんた達ってば、\n料理の事を、な〜んもわかってないわ
traducao: Haaaah...\nYou people honestly know\nnothing about cooking whatsoever!

original: おぉ、救世主が……！
traducao: Whoa, a savior has arrived...!

original: いい？
traducao: Listen up!

original: 人間に必要な栄養素を食材で摂るんなら\n明らかにミルクが足りないでしょ！\nミルクが！！
traducao: If you want essential nutrients from food,\nit's clearly lacking milk!\nMILK, I say!!

original: あの中に、ミルクを足すって……。\n正気かよ！？
traducao: Adding milk into THAT...?\nAre you out of your damn mind?!

original: なるほど……。\n確かに一理ある意見だわ
traducao: I see...\nThat is actually a reasonable point.

original: よし。\nそれじゃミルクを足して、と
traducao: All right.\nLet's add the milk, then.

original: 出来ましたわ！\n滋養強壮に効果ありの\n特製スープの完成ですわ！
traducao: It is finished!\nOur special stamina-boosting soup\nis complete!

original: さ、ルーク。\nお食べなさい
traducao: Come now, Luke.\nHave some!

original: え、俺か！？\nい、いや、それはちょっと……
traducao: Wait, me?!\nN-No, I-I'd really rather not...

original: ほら、ロイドも
traducao: Here, you too, Lloyd.

original: お、俺は……
traducao: I-I was just......

original: 滋養強壮なんだから、\nやっぱり最年長のクラトスに\n最初に食べてもらったら？
traducao: Since it boosts stamina,\nshouldn't Kratos, the oldest one here,\nget the first taste?

original: ほら、クラトス。\n遠慮しないで食べて
traducao: Come on, Kratos.\nDon't be shy, dig in!

original: む……。\nこ、この匂いは……
traducao: Hmm......\nT-This smell is......

original: クラトス、止めとけ……！\n腹壊すぞ、マジで……！！
traducao: Kratos, don't do it...!\nYou'll wreck your stomach, seriously...!!

original: し、しかし……
遠慮する事はないわ。\nさぁ、早く∀
traducao: There is no need to hold back.\nCome, eat up! :)
U-Ugh... v-very well......

original: では、頂くとするか……
traducao: Then, I suppose I shall indulge......

original: ダメだーーーー！！！
traducao: NOOOOOOOOOOO!!!

original: ユーリ
traducao: Yuri.

original: ん？　何だ？
traducao: Hm? What's up?

original: お前は今の様な生き方を\nこのまま続けていくつもりか？
traducao: Do you intend to continue\nliving your life the way you do?

original: オレは、オレだからな。\n他の奴が何言おうが関係ねぇし
traducao: I'm just being me.\nDoesn't matter what anyone else says.

original: 例え汚れ役であったとしても\nあくまで己の信念に基づき、動くと？
traducao: Even if you must play the villain,\nyou act strictly on your convictions?

original: ま、そういう性分だから、仕方ねぇよ
traducao: Well, that's my nature. Can't be helped.

original: 誰に理解されなくとも\nあえてその道を選ぶというのか
traducao: Even if no one understands,\nyou deliberately choose that path?

original: 性分ってのは、そういうもんじゃねぇのか？\nクラトス、あんただって同じだろ？
traducao: Isn't that just how nature works?\nKratos, aren't you the same way?

original: フ……。\nさあな
traducao: Heh...\nWho can say?

original: ○○、聞いて。\nあなたのこれまで討伐した\n魔物の総数が……
traducao: Listen, ○○.\nThe total number of monsters\nyou've slain up until now...

original: 何と！　\n１０００体を超えたの！
traducao: Believe it or not,\nhas surpassed 1,000!

original: １０００体だって？
traducao: Did you say 1,000?!

original: すごいじゃないか、\n○○！
traducao: That's incredible,\n○○!

original: ふむ……。\n日頃の鍛錬の成果が\n着実に積み重なった結果だろう
traducao: Hmm...\nThis is the steady accumulation\nof your daily training paying off.

original: これまで色んな仕事を\nお願いしてきたけど
traducao: We've asked you to handle\nso many different jobs, but...

original: ここまで働いてくれるとは\n正直、思ってなかったかな。\nちょっと感動しちゃった
traducao: Honestly, I never imagined you would\nwork this hard for us.\nI'm truly touched.

original: 俺も負けてられないな……
traducao: I can't let myself fall behind, either...

original: よ〜し、クレスに剣の稽古に\n付き合ってもらうぞ！
traducao: All right! I'll ask Cress to spar\nwith me for some sword practice!

original: 倒した魔物の数がすごいのではない
traducao: A high monster count is not what matters.

original: お前の前向きな行動が\n自然と周囲に良き影響を与え\n魔物討伐数という形で、一つの結果を生んだ
traducao: Your earnest actions naturally brought\na positive influence upon those around\nyou, yielding this result.

original: その自然な連環こそが\nお前の強さの本質であり、最大の武器なのだ
traducao: That natural cycle is the true essence\nof your strength and your greatest weapon.

original: ……これからも、鍛錬を怠るなよ
traducao: ......Do not neglect your training.

original: ふふ、珍しい人から\nありがたいお説教をもらっちゃったね
traducao: Hehe, quite rare to receive such\na thoughtful sermon from him, isn't it?

original: わたしも、これからも頼りにしてるよ。\n一緒に頑張っていきましょう、\n○○
traducao: I'll be counting on you as well.\nLet's keep doing our best together,\n○○.

original: これから、世界は\nどうなっていくのかしら……
traducao: What is going to become\nof the world from here on......?

original: わからないわ……ただ、
traducao: I don't know...... However,

original: このままラザリスの浸食が進めば\nそう遠くない未来に、取り返しのつかない\n事態になる……それだけは確かね
traducao: If Lazaris continues to erode our world,\nirreversible disaster will soon strike...\nThat much is certain.

original: ……不安か？
traducao: ......Are you anxious?

original: え、ええ……
traducao: Y-Yes...

original: この先の事を考えると……\nどうしても……
traducao: When I think of what lies ahead...\nI can't help it......

original: ならばまず、その負の感情を\n捨て去る事だ
traducao: Then you must first discard\nthose negative emotions.

original: 捨てる……？\n不安になるなという事？
traducao: Discard them...?\nAre you telling us not to worry?

original: 未来が不確かだからといって\n恐れを抱いて何になる？\nそれは「まだ起きていない」のだ
traducao: What good is feeling fear over\nan uncertain future?\nIt has 'not happened yet.'

original: 必要なのは、今から先へと踏み出す一歩、\nその為の一握の勇気だろう
traducao: All you need is a single step forward,\nand a handful of courage to take it.

original: 確かに……わたし達の不安は\n望まない未来を思い描く事で\n生まれているわ
traducao: You're right... Our anxieties\narise because we picture\na future we do not desire.

original: その不安が恐れとなり、\n一歩を踏み出す勇気を奪う……。\n結果、望む未来からは遠ざかる……
traducao: That anxiety turns into fear,\nrobbing us of courage to step forward...\nAs a result, our desired future fades...

original: ……わたし達の不安が、逆に\n望まない未来を引き寄せてしまっているのね
traducao: ......So our very fears are actually\ndrawing an unwanted future closer to us.

original: そういう事だ
traducao: Precisely.

original: 慎重を期す事と臆病である事は違う。\nそれを肝に銘じておく事だ
traducao: Caution and cowardice are not the same.\nYou would do well to remember that.

original: ア……アウリオン！
traducao: A-Aurion!

original: ……何だ
traducao: ...What is it?

original: え、えっと……その……。\nこの間は、すまなかった
traducao: U-Um... well, you see...\nI apologize for the other day.

original: 怒鳴ったりして……恥ずかしく思う
traducao: Yelling at you... I feel so ashamed.

original: ただ、私に何か至らぬ所があったのなら\nそう言ってはもらえないか？\nこのままでは……あまりに、その……
traducao: However, if there was some inadequacy\nin me, would you tell me?\nLeaving things as they are is... well...

original: フッ……
traducao: Hmph...

original: な、何だ。\n何がおかしい？
traducao: Wh-What is it?\nWhat's so funny?

original: いや、よく私と\n話をする気になったものだと思ってな
traducao: No, I was simply thinking it took quite\nsome nerve for you to speak with me.

original: ……それは……コレットが\n貴公の真意を問えと言うから……
traducao: ......That is only because Colette told\nme to ask your true intentions...

original: それでいいのだ。\n大切なのは、他人の話に耳を傾け\n己の解釈に常に疑問を持つ事だ
traducao: That is fine as well.\nThe important thing is listening to others\nand questioning your own interpretations.

original: な……何？
traducao: Wh-What?

original: 物事は如何様にでも解釈出来る。\n人間も同じだ。　初めから善人と悪人が\nこの世にいるわけではない
traducao: Things can be interpreted in any way.\nHumans are the same. People are not\nborn into this world good or evil.

original: だが……事実、悪党はいるじゃないか。\nこの間だって……
traducao: Still... villains do exist in truth!\nEven just the other day...

original: 善悪を定めているのは、己の心だ。\nならば、その心が真に正しく在るか\n常に疑いを持たねば、真実は遠ざかる
traducao: One's own heart defines good and evil.\nUnless you constantly doubt its justice,\nthe truth will forever elude you.

original: ……お前も騎士を名乗るなら\n常に正義と善悪の在り処を、\n己に問いかけ続ける事だ
traducao: ......If you call yourself a knight,\nyou must constantly ask yourself where\ntrue justice, good, and evil truly lie.

original: ……私は……間違っていたのか？
traducao: ......Was I...... mistaken?

original: クラトスさん、大丈夫キュ？\n疲れてないキュ？
traducao: Are you all right, Mr. Kratos, kyu?\nYou're not tired, are you, kyu?

original: ……どういう事だ？
traducao: ......What do you mean?

original: いつもより、眉間のしわが\nちょっと深いキュ
traducao: The furrow in your brow is\na bit deeper than usual, kyu!

original: ……というのは冗談キュ
traducao: ......Just kidding, kyu!

original: クラトスさんは、本物の戦士だキュ。\nだから、簡単には弱音を吐かないキュ
traducao: Mr. Kratos is a true warrior, kyu.\nSo you'd never easily complain, kyu.

original: 辛い事も、苦しい事も我慢して……\n我慢が積もると、だんだん\n心が固くなってくるものだキュ
traducao: Enduring pain, enduring hardship...\nWhen endurance piles up, your heart\nslowly turns rigid, kyu.

original: ……フッ……\n心配してくれている、という事か
traducao: ......Heh......\nSo you were concerned for me, then.

original: 無理は禁物だキュ。\n無理と我慢は、心と体に良くないキュ
traducao: Overdoing things is forbidden, kyu!\nStrain and overwork harm your body, kyu!

original: ……そうだな
traducao: ......Indeed.

original: お腹が空いたら、\nいつでもここに来るといいキュ
traducao: If you get hungry,\nfeel free to come here anytime, kyu!

original: クラトスさんなら、同じ戦士として\n上等のホタテを、ちょっとだけ\nわけてあげてもいいキュ！
traducao: For you, Mr. Kratos, a fellow warrior,\nI wouldn't mind sharing a tiny bit\nof top-grade scallop with you, kyu!

original: ……ああ、わかった
traducao: ......Very well.

original: 考えておくとしよう
traducao: I will keep that in mind.

traducao: Normal.\n

traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.
